goal: Native Codex Stop cancels owned ChatGPT Web generation and retains the same saved conversation and tab through a separately owned MCP adapter, using the unmodified signed official CLI.

narrowTrialIdentity.scope: One allowlisted ordinary primary-model conversation; subagents excluded.

localVerification.scope: Focused checks cover adapter authority, callback lifecycle, fixed cleanup, deadlines, installer ownership and rollback. Synthetic regressions distinguish terminal-observation cleanup behavior; this live success does not establish which polling race occurred.

limits: The all-ordinary configuration loaded after a normal restart, actual Stop passed and the following turn completed in the same saved chat, tab and binding. This was one live primary-model conversation; separate ordinary identities and subagent exclusion are covered by focused regressions.
Only the named Instant Web route at low effort was live tested. Other models and Web subagents were not certified.
The 897 ms narrow-trial and 917 ms all-ordinary measurements cover adapter cleanup callbacks, not end-to-end latency from the user's Stop gesture.
No native coding command ran in this Stop trial; it does not establish Web-to-native command sandbox enforcement or resolve the earlier hosted connector HTTP 429.
Earlier failed disposable adapters and the separate patched-native candidate remain historical evidence. This result does not retroactively validate those attempts.
The separate native-patch installation and its rollback evidence are preserved in 2026-10-18-native-hook-context.json.
privacy: Raw saved-chat URLs, native thread and turn identifiers, turn tokens, private prompts, tool payloads, credentials and private filesystem paths are omitted.
